jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Für Deine Accounts verantwortest Du die gesamte Kundenbeziehung  – vom ersten Pitch über Listungen und Verhandlung bis hin zur gemeinsamen Geschäftsplanung.  Dabei bringst Du das kanalübergreifende Denken mit, um unsere Digital-Native-Marke nachhaltig im stationären Regal zu etablieren. Du treibst Upselling-Entwicklungen und Sortimentserweiterungen bei Bestandskunden voran und maximierst Produktverfügbarkeit sowie Sichtbarkeit am Point of Sale. Du planst und steuerst messbare, kanalübergreifende Initiativen, die D2C-Aktivitäten optimal mit dem stationären Handel verknüpfen. jobs.title: Freelance Acquisition Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
jobs.description: Nous recherchons un(e) consultant(e) freelance spécialisé(e) en acquisition payante pour intervenir sur plusieurs projets e-commerce dans la beauté, la nutrition et la santé. Notre terrain de jeu : l'acquisition payante nourrie par les contenus de créateurs . Spark Ads, whitelisting, Partnership Ads, amplification de contenus UGC. Si vous savez transformer une vidéo de créatrice en campagne rentable, cette mission est pour vous. Nous recherchons un partenaire capable aussi bien d'optimiser des dispositifs existants que de construire une stratégie paid media de A à Z pour de nouvelles marques ou de nouveaux marchés. Cette première mission pourra déboucher sur une collaboration récurrente. Vos missions 1. Audit et optimisation de l'existant Auditer les comptes Google Ads, Meta Ads et TikTok Ads. Identifier les principaux freins à la performance (tracking, structure des campagnes, ciblages, créas, audiences, budget, attribution). Construire un plan d'actions priorisé selon l'impact business, puis le mettre en œuvre. Suivre les performances et formuler de nouvelles recommandations. 2. Amplification des contenus créateurs Sélectionner les contenus UGC et créateurs à fort potentiel publicitaire. Mettre en place les autorisations (Spark Ads, whitelisting, Partnership Ads) avec les créateurs. Tester les hooks, formats et angles, puis industrialiser ce qui performe. 3. Construction d'une stratégie d'acquisition sur un nouveau marché Sur l'un des projets, vous définirez et déploierez une stratégie d'acquisition payante sur les réseaux sociaux pour accompagner le lancement d'un concept sur le marché américain : choix des plateformes et des formats, architecture des campagnes, audiences, premiers tests, optimisation continue. Selon les projets, la mission pourra évoluer vers un pilotage mensuel des campagnes. Vos compétences Nous recherchons un profil senior, opérationnel, qui pilote lui-même les comptes. Indispensable : une expérience réelle des Spark Ads, du whitelisting ou des Creator Ads, avec des résultats à montrer. Une excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads et TikTok Ads. Une solide expérience sur Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max). Un tracking propre : GA4, GTM, Pixel, API Conversions. Une approche orientée rentabilité : ROAS, CPA, marge. Une expérience de marques e-commerce D2C (cosmétique, beauté, nutrition, santé) sera particulièrement appréciée, tout comme une expérience à l'international. Conditions Mission freelance, 350 à 380 € par jour selon profil. 100 % à distance, depuis l'Europe : nous travaillons sur le fuseau de Paris et les échanges se font en journée (UTC-1 à UTC+3). Statut d'indépendant en règle. Pour postuler Merci de nous donner un résultat chiffré avant / après sur une campagne que vous avez pilotée (ROAS, CPA ou CAC, budget mensuel, période). Les candidatures sans aucun chiffre ne seront pas étudiées. Joignez aussi : deux ou trois références de missions similaires, idéalement avec des contenus créateurs ; votre niveau sur Google Ads, Meta Ads et TikTok Ads ; votre disponibilité pour démarrer. jobs.title: iOS Software Engineer
jobs.description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations. Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things. Role As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical. Focus Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI. Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs. Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks. Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency. Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration. Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API design and system behavior. Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability. Ideal Experiences 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift. Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps. Strong understanding of async/await, concurrency, and background tasks. Solid iOS performance and memory optimization skills. Experience shipping and maintaining production iOS apps. Comfort designing for latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic AI behavior. Exposure to CoreML or light on-device ML. Familiarity with feature flags or remote configuration systems. Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and user trust considerations. Outcomes Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use iOS applications. Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU. Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis. Tech Stack Swift SPM SwiftUI SQL / noSQL TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference) How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werden Sie Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewerben Sie sich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche. Für unsere Unternehmensgruppe suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Sie als  (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d) . Was Sie bei uns bewegen: Permanente Durchführung von Passform- und Qualitätskontrollen Produktionsfreigabe anhand Mustertypen Kontinuierlicher Austausch innerhalb des Produktmanagements und mit den internationalen Produktionsstätten Was uns ausmacht: Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, flachen Hierarchien und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur. Alles, was Sie zum Arbeiten benötigen: Klimatisierte Büros, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung. Ein Arbeitstag, wie für Sie gemacht: Dank unserer flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle können Sie Ihr Berufsleben optimal an ihr Privatleben anpassen. Mit uns profitieren Sie von Sonderkonditionen und Angeboten bei verschiedensten Vertragspartnern über das Portal corporate Benefits. Durch einen Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Fabrikverkauf sowie im Tamaris Onlineshop füllt sich der Schuhschrank wie von alleine. Niemand tritt gerne auf der Stelle: Durch Schulungen und Seminare fördern wir Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildung, denn Ihr Karriereweg ist keine Einbahnstraße. Fit und entspannt im Alltag: Durch verschiedene kostenlose Betriebssportgruppen, eine Kooperation mit lokalen Fitnessstudios sowie mit dem Anbieter sportnavi.de. jobs.title: Projekt & Operations Manager (m/w/d)

Unser Kunde entwickelt und fertigt autonome Drohnensysteme, Einsatzsoftware und spezialisierte Lösungen für Industrie, Netzbetreiber, Behörden und maritime Anwendungen. Dabei entstehen hochspezialisierte Systeme, die Hardware, Software und autonome Technologien miteinander verbinden und bereits bei namhaften Kunden zum Einsatz kommen. Technologieumfeld: Arbeite an innovativen Drohnensystemen und autonomen Technologien mit anspruchsvollen Anwendungen. Unternehmenskultur: Flache Strukturen, offene Kommunikation und ein motiviertes Team mit hoher Technikaffinität. Mobiles Arbeiten: Homeoffice ist nach Absprache möglich, sofern es die jeweiligen Aufgaben und die operative Situation erlauben. Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Ausstattung mit aktueller Hard und Software sowie kurze Wege zwischen Entwicklung, Produktion und Projektmanagement. Teamspirit: Regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten und Teamevents sorgen für ein persönliches und unkompliziertes Miteinander. Individuelle Benefits: Persönliche Wünsche und Vorschläge sind willkommen. Gemeinsam werden individuelle Benefits erarbeitet. Deine Aufgaben Als Projekt & Operations Managerübernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle im operativen Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte, Ressourcen und interne Abläufe zuverlässig ineinandergreifen. Operative Steuerung: Koordination des täglichen Geschäftsbetriebs über die Bereiche Werkstatt, Produktion, Entwicklung, Projektkoordination, Beschaffung und Flugbetrieb hinweg. Projektkoordination: Steuerung mehrerer paralleler Entwicklungs-, Liefer- und Forschungsprojekte hinsichtlich Terminen, Ressourcen, Qualität und Budgets. Priorisierung: Wöchentliche Abstimmung der Projektprioritäten, Kapazitäten und Ressourcen sowie eigenständige Lösung entstehender Konflikte. Produktion: Koordination von Produktion, Ausgangsprüfung und Auslieferung der Drohnensysteme. Prozesse: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung effizienter operativer Abläufe in Bereichen wie Projektplanung, Aufgabensteuerung, Einkauf, Lager und Qualitätsmanagement. Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen aus Entwicklung, Produktion, Projektmanagement und weiteren internen Bereichen. Projektmanagement: Unterstützung und Koordination bei Kundenprojekten, Lieferungen, Abnahmen und weiteren operativen Vorhaben. Compliance: Koordination relevanter Themen rund um Exportkontrolle, Zoll und erforderliche Dokumentationen. Geschäftsführung: Entlastung des Geschäftsführers im operativen Tagesgeschäft, damit dieser sich stärker auf Strategie, Technologie und Schlüsselkunden konzentrieren kann. Weiterentwicklung: Erkennen von Verbesserungspotenzialen und eigenständiges Vorantreiben von Maßnahmen zur Skalierung und Automatisierung der operativen Abläufe. Dein Profil als Proje

jobs.title: Co-Founder*in: Business Development, B2B-Marketing & Hospitality (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über uns: Wer ist Modumat und was treibt uns an? Wir sind Modumat – und wir gestalten die Zukunft der smarten, nachhaltigen Warenausgabe! Klassische Verkaufsautomaten sind oft klobig, unflexibel, wartungsintensiv und verbrauchen unnötig viele Ressourcen. Mit unserem modularen Hardware- und Softwareansatz denken wir das Prinzip neu: Wir machen automatisierte Versorgung flexibel anpassbar, datengestützt und ressourcenschonend. Damit schaffen wir echten Mehrwert im Alltag – von der smarten Snack-Station bis zur einladenden, vollautomatisierten 24/7-Micro-Lobby in Hotels. Hinter Modumat stehen wir: Raphael und Frederik , zwei Informatik-Masterstudenten an der Hochschule Darmstadt (h_da). Unser erster Prototyp läuft bereits erfolgreich im Live-Betrieb bei einem Pilotkunden, und unsere Vision wurde jüngst mit der Dörte-Wörner-Innovationsförderung ausgezeichnet. Da wir im Frühjahr unseren Master abschließen, gehen wir nun gemeinsam den nächsten Schritt: Wir beantragen das EXIST-Gründerstipendium , um Modumat als nachhaltig wachsendes Vollzeit-Startup (GmbH) aufzubauen. Unsere Technologie steht auf einem stabilen Fundament. Jetzt fehlst du uns als 3. Kernteammitglied – die strategische, kommunikative und wirtschaftliche Perspektive für unser Gründungsteam! Was du bei Modumat bewegst Als kaufmännische und kommunikative Säule unseres Teams verbindest du unsere Technologie mit den Menschen und Märkten, die sie brauchen: Markenaufbau & B2B-Kommunikation: Du entwickelst unsere Positionierungsstrategie, verleihst Modumat eine starke Stimme und machst unsere Lösung bei relevanten B2B-Zielgruppen sichtbar (über LinkedIn, Branchen-Events, gezieltes Storytelling und Kampagnen). Fokus Hospitality & Gästeerlebnis: Du tauchst tief in die Welt der Hotellerie ein (z. B. moderne 24/7-Lobby-Konzepte, smarter Minibar-Ersatz, Entlastung des Hotelpersonals) und gestaltest gemeinsam mit Entscheidungsträger*innen der Branche Lösungen, die Gäste und Hotelteams gleichermaßen begeistern. Partnerschaften & Kundenbeziehungen: Du baust nachhaltige Beziehungen zu B2B-Partnern auf (Hotels, Coworking-Spaces, moderne Gastgeber) und gewinnst gemeinsam mit uns erste Pilotpartner sowie Letters of Intent (LOIs) für den EXIST-Antrag. Geschäftsmodell & EXIST-Antrag: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den wirtschaftlichen Teil unserer Gründungsreise – von der Markt- und Zielgruppenanalyse über faire Pricing-Modelle bis hin zur Finanzplanung im Rahmen des EXIST-Stipendiums. Webpräsenz & Außenwirkung: Du gestaltest unseren Auftritt (Website, Pitch Decks, Kommunikationsmaterial) so, dass aus innovativer Technik verständliche, einladende Mehrwerte für unsere Kund*innen werden. Was du mitbringst (Hinweis: Du musst noch nicht in jedem einzelnen Punkt jahrelange Erfahrung haben – viel wichtiger ist uns deine Begeisterung, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen!) Studienhintergrund: Du studierst BWL, Marketing, Hospitality-/Tourismus-Management, International Business, Kommunikationsmanagement, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach (kurz vor dem Masterabschluss oder bereits abgeschlossen). Gespür für Hospitality & Service (großes Plus): Du kennst die Dynamik der Hotellerie oder Gastronomie (z. B. Personalmangel, Gästebedürfnisse, 24/7-Service) aus Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder deinem Netzwerk – oder du hast große Lust, diese spannende Branche mit sinnstiftender Technologie zu unterstützen. Kommunikationsstärke & Kundenfokus: Du hörst Kund*innen genau zu, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und kannst komplexe Produkte empathisch, klar und überzeugend vermitteln. Offenheit für Tech & moderne KI-Tools: Du musst keine Zeile Code schreiben. Wichtig ist, dass du neugierig auf digitale Innovationen bist und moderne KI-Tools (wie ChatGPT, Canva/Design-Tools oder Recherche-Tools) gerne nutzt, um dir den Arbeitsalltag kreativ und effizient zu erleichtern. jobs.title: UX Copywriter
jobs.description: Who we are: We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay. We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers. Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us? About the role. We’re looking for a UX copywriter to join our copy team and help bring the Zilch brand to life across every digital customer touchpoint. Your primary focus will be partnering with Product Design to create clear and intuitive experiences across our app and website. Working closely with product designers, product managers and engineers, you'll contribute to creating customer journeys from discovery through to launch. You'll also collaborate with teams across the business, including Marketing, Customer Support and Operations, providing specialist copy support wherever it's needed – from SEO content and help articles to customer communications and product launches. This isn't just about writing functional copy. It's about creating experiences customers understand, trust and enjoy. You'll know when to keep things simple, when to inject personality and how to bring the Zilch tone of voice to life in even the smallest moments. We're looking for a creative and tactical thinker who understands that great UX copy does more than guide users from A to B. It solves problems, removes friction and creates experiences that feel simple, human and unmistakably Zilch. Day to day responsibilities. Partner with Product Design to create clear, engaging copy across the app and website, from new features to end-to-end customer journeys. Collaborate with product managers, designers and engineers throughout the product development process, from discovery through to launch. Write and optimise customer-facing content across digital touchpoints, including help articles, FAQs, SEO content and operational communications. Balance customer needs, business goals and regulatory requirements to create content that's clear, helpful and compliant. Use customer insight, data and testing to improve the content and customer journeys. Champion accessibility, consistency and best practice in UX writing and content design. Support wider business priorities with copy for product launches, campaigns and new initiatives when needed. What we’re looking for... You're a brilliant writer with experience creating content for digital products. Whether you've called yourself a UX Writer, Content Designer or Copywriter, you know how to use words to solve problems. You can switch effectively between product thinking and brand thinking. One minute you're refining onboarding copy, the next you're shaping a product launch or crafting a headline that makes someone smile. You know that the best digital experiences don't happen by accident. You're curious, ask the right questions and enjoy getting to the root of a problem before putting pen to paper. You care about craft. Every word has a purpose, every interaction has intent and you're never afraid to rewrite something until it feels just right. You understand our tone of voice and apply it consistently across customer communications, recognising how a brand comes to life through product. You know how to create experiences that feel consistent, human and unmistakably Zilch. You're a natural collaborator who enjoys bouncing ideas around with designers, product managers, marketers and developers. You know the best work happens when different disciplines come together. You're comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve, and you enjoy the variety that comes with it. Experience with Figma is important. Experience writing for SEO or in a regulated industry would be a bonus. Benefits. Compensation & Savings: Pension scheme. Death in Service scheme. Income Protection. Permanen

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description: We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure. At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform. Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage , and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox , and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026 . About the role As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built. We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it. What you’ll be doing Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions , pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t Managing our outsourced bookkeeping , accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it , actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App. This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads. What You'll Own Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas. Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads. Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution. Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services. Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions. Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement. Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement. What We're Looking For Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features. Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes. Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing. Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage. Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure. Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys. Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage. The Kind of Builder We Want Can set direction and still go deep into details. Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality. Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no. Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy. Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams. This Role Is Not For Product leaders who only manage people and meetings. People who cannot go deep into product details. Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment. Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact. People who need large teams before they can create progress. Location This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. jobs.title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
jobs.description: 📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques. Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer . Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse , vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites. Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique . Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance . Vos missions Votre rôle Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite . Vous êtes à la fois : un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ; un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ; un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents. Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre. Vos principales missions 1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels. jobs.description: About this position As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working. Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight. Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions. Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions. Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment. jobs.description: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis) Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you. Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland) About Intero Integrity Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data. The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement. We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact. The opportunity This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide. What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week. Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here. jobs.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Integrity Engineer Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it. Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe. About Intero Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities. Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity . Your team You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department. Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients. Why this role matters An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on. What your week looks like Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments. ·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it. ·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards. ·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities. ·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions. ·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data. ·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards. ·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early. Managing product timelines and deliverables, making sure that the SoC Development follows the planned schedule and stays within budget. Strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot and resolve architectural issues related to SoC integration, performance, and power efficiency. Experienced with silicon bring-up, validation, and post-silicon debug methodologies. Jij vertaalt klantwensen naar betrouwbare, duurzame en toekomstbestendige elektrotechnische installaties, van energievoorziening tot communicatie- en beveiligingssystemen. Ondersteunen van de ontwerpleider en projectmanager in de communicatie met klanten en partners.   Hier is waar   We hebben gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling en het ontwerp van een duurzaam en modern gebouw voor het Nederlands Instituut voor Ruimteonderzoek (SRON), dat meetinstrumenten voor satellieten ontwikkelt. Als onderzoeksinstituut gewijd aan het bestuderen van de aardatmosfeer vond SRON het belangrijk om de impact op natuur en milieu te minimaliseren. Op basis van de inval van zonlicht in het gebouw, de energieprestatie-eisen en de strenge eisen voor de binnentemperatuur ontwierp Deerns een gevel die voor 25% gesloten is. jobs.description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day. As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands. You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together. You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected. You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law. You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence. You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early. You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster. You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years. In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production. Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough. You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description: Of je jezelf nu UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer noemt: jij zorgt ervoor dat digitale producten en services logisch werken voor de mensen die ze gebruiken. Je beweegt makkelijk tussen strategie, gebruikersbehoeften, interactie en technologie. Van eerste inzicht en concept tot een uitgewerkt ontwerp dat daadwerkelijk gebouwd en gebruikt wordt. Wat ga je doen als UX Designer bij Norday? Bij Norday werken we aan complexe vraagstukken waarvoor niet altijd meteen duidelijk is wat de juiste oplossing is. Nieuwe technologie, veranderende verwachtingen en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen vragen organisaties om richting te kiezen én die richting concreet te maken. Als UX Designer help jij daarbij. Je vergroot de verbeeldingskracht van opdrachtgevers met scherpe inzichten en snelle prototypes. Je onderzoekt wat mensen nodig hebben, maakt complexe informatie begrijpelijk en vertaalt strategische keuzes naar digitale producten en services die in de praktijk werken. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met strategen, service designers, visual designers, developers en projectmanagers. Je werkt aan nieuwe digitale platforms, slimme tools, gepersonaliseerde ervaringen en nieuwe diensten. Soms ligt er al een duidelijke strategie, soms help je die samen met het team verder vormgeven. Je bent gedurende het hele proces betrokken: van het eerste vraagstuk en onderzoek tot concept, ontwerp, validatie en realisatie. Wat je gaat doen: Je duikt in de context van een vraagstuk en brengt gebruikers, behoeften, doelen en knelpunten in kaart; Je vertaalt inzichten en strategie naar een concept, user flows, journeys en prototypes; Je maakt complexe vraagstukken begrijpelijk en helpt klanten en teams om keuzes te maken; Je faciliteert workshops en co-creatiesessies met klanten, gebruikers en collega’s; Je bedenkt en test verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en gebruikt inzichten uit onderzoek om je ontwerp steeds verder aan te scherpen; Je onderzoekt hoe AI kan bijdragen aan nieuwe diensten, betere ervaringen en waarde voor organisaties en de mensen die ze gebruiken; Je zorgt dat interacties, flows en details helder zijn voor visual designers, developers én agents; Je bewaakt de gebruikerservaring tot het product of de service daadwerkelijk werkt; Je werkt samen met strategen en andere disciplines aan oplossingen die niet alleen prettig werken, maar bijdragen aan de richting en waarde van de organisatie. You'll expand our end-to-end test coverage in Playwright and help build robust approaches for validating AI-powered systems, where quality extends beyond functional correctness. This is a hands-on, collaborative role with genuine ownership, direct impact on product development, and the opportunity to shape how we test AI at Tellent. Your 12-Month Journey During your first 3 months: You'll get to know our Tellent Intelligence domain, engineering practices, AI-powered features, and quality standards. You'll learn our testing framework and development workflow while contributing to automated, exploratory, and AI-focused testing. Within 6 months: You'll take ownership of quality across key AI-powered features, expand our Playwright test coverage, and work closely with engineers to validate AI behaviour, prompts, and model-driven functionality throughout development. After 1 year: You'll be a trusted quality partner within the Tellent Intelligence team, driving improvements to our AI testing strategy, strengthening our automation framework, and helping shape how we build reliable, safe, and responsible AI experiences across Tellent. What You'll Be Doing Work closely with fellow Quality Engineers to bring our test automation strategy to life across the Tellent Intelligence domain, taking shared ownership and continuously improving it as our platform evolves. Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites across frontend, backend, and AI-powered functionality. Develop into a product domain expert, using your understanding to identify risks early and guide quality decisions across the Tellent Intelligence domain. Design and execute testing strategies for AI-powered features, validating not only functional correctness but also the quality, relevance, consistency, and safety of AI-generated outputs. E2E automation: Experience building and maintaining end-to-end test suites in Playwright. API & backend testing skills: Experience testing APIs and backend services. Understanding of AI testing challenges: Familiarity with concepts such as prompt engineering, AI agents, hallucinations, model bias, evaluation datasets, and AI safety prin

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage IT
jobs.description: Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou! BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure. 2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering) In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk. Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt. 3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering) Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken. Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability. 4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management) Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen. Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant. 5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product) Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World. Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse. Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop. jobs.description: Über uns: Wer ist Modumat und was treibt uns an? Wir sind Modumat – und wir gestalten die Zukunft der smarten, nachhaltigen Warenausgabe! Klassische Verkaufsautomaten sind oft klobig, unflexibel, wartungsintensiv und verbrauchen unnötig viele Ressourcen. Mit unserem modularen Hardware- und Softwareansatz denken wir das Prinzip neu: Wir machen automatisierte Versorgung flexibel anpassbar, datengestützt und ressourcenschonend. Damit schaffen wir echten Mehrwert im Alltag – von der smarten Snack-Station bis zur einladenden, vollautomatisierten 24/7-Micro-Lobby in Hotels. Hinter Modumat stehen wir: Raphael und Frederik , zwei Informatik-Masterstudenten an der Hochschule Darmstadt (h_da). Unser erster Prototyp läuft bereits erfolgreich im Live-Betrieb bei einem Pilotkunden, und unsere Vision wurde jüngst mit der Dörte-Wörner-Innovationsförderung ausgezeichnet. Da wir im Frühjahr unseren Master abschließen, gehen wir nun gemeinsam den nächsten Schritt: Wir beantragen das EXIST-Gründerstipendium , um Modumat als nachhaltig wachsendes Vollzeit-Startup (GmbH) aufzubauen. Unsere Technologie steht auf einem stabilen Fundament. Jetzt fehlst du uns als 3. Kernteammitglied – die strategische, kommunikative und wirtschaftliche Perspektive für unser Gründungsteam! Was du bei Modumat bewegst Als kaufmännische und kommunikative Säule unseres Teams verbindest du unsere Technologie mit den Menschen und Märkten, die sie brauchen: Markenaufbau & B2B-Kommunikation: Du entwickelst unsere Positionierungsstrategie, verleihst Modumat eine starke Stimme und machst unsere Lösung bei relevanten B2B-Zielgruppen sichtbar (über LinkedIn, Branchen-Events, gezieltes Storytelling und Kampagnen). Fokus Hospitality & Gästeerlebnis: Du tauchst tief in die Welt der Hotellerie ein (z. B. moderne 24/7-Lobby-Konzepte, smarter Minibar-Ersatz, Entlastung des Hotelpersonals) und gestaltest gemeinsam mit Entscheidungsträger*innen der Branche Lösungen, die Gäste und Hotelteams gleichermaßen begeistern. jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity. The Flight Software Architect plays a key role in defining and maintaining the software architecture for our spacecraft flight software. The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include: What we would love to see from you Software architecture & design — Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives. Technical leadership & architectural decisions — Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. Provide technical guidance to software engineers and ensure consistency across software components and development activities. System integration & interfaces — Define and coordinate software interfaces with avionics, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, GNC, communication systems, and other spacecraft subsystems. Ensure robust integration across functional disciplines and support the resolution of cross-system technical challenges. Requirements & traceability — Translate mission and system-level requirements into software architectural requirements, design constraints, and interface specifications. Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification, working closely with Systems Engineering and functional chain owners. Reliability, safety & performance — Ensure that architectural decisions address fault tolerance, robustness, timing constraints, resource utilization, failure detection and recovery, and overall spacecraft reliability. Contribute to safety analyses, failure management strategies, and the definition of appropriate software verification and validation approaches. Verification, validation & technical risk management — Identify and mitigate architectural risks, assess technical trade-offs, and support design reviews, integration campaigns, and verification activities. Ensure that the architecture is validated against mission requirements and that critical technical assumptions are verified early in the development lifecycle. Cross-functional collaboration & technical communication — Act as a technical reference for flight software architecture, facilitating alignment between Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and external partners, including ESA where applicable. Communicate architectural decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and project stakeholders. In the role of Flight Software Architect, ideally, you will have the following: 10–15 years of professional experience in software engineering, including substantial experience in flight software, embedded software, or safety- and mission-critical systems. Proven experience defining and evolving software architectures for complex critical software systems , ideally for spacecraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications. Strong knowledge of real-time embedded software , operating systems, hardware–software interfaces, resource-constrained computing, and distributed or fault-tolerant systems. jobs.description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App. This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads. What You'll Own Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas. Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads. Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution. Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Neobank. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. What We're Looking For Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role. Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows. Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products. Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning. Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management. High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance. Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage. The Kind of Builder We Want Starts from user problems, not feature lists. Can make decisions with incomplete information. Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch. Works well with engineering without hiding behind process. Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort. This Role Is Not For People who only write decks and do not drive execution. PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering. Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions. People who launch features and then stop caring. PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution. Location This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Founding lead Product Designer
jobs.description: Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions. We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates. We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies. Tasks User Research & Discovery Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks. Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in. Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people. Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision. Product & Experience Design What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it. Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves. Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have. Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products. Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot. Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them. Requirements 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products. A strong portfolio that shows both craft and thinking: we want to see how you operated, not just what shipped. A skilled researcher who can design a study, run it in the wild, and turn qualitative chaos into clear direction. Experience designing inside environments you don't control - a messaging client, an extension, an embedded product - or a clear appetite for it. Comfortable designing for AI-driven and adaptive experiences, where the interface has to handle uncertainty, personalization, and non-linear workflows. Excellent visual and interaction design skills: typography, spacing, motion, and the small details that build trust. Autonomous and opinionated, but you hold your opinions loosely when the evidence says otherwise. Genuine curiosity about AI and how people actually learn at work. Fluent in French and English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus. You want the ownership, equity, and career-defining challenge that only comes from being early. Bonus: deeply passionate about something outside of work. Benefits A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy. Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Paris startup ecosystem

Ici les postes ne sont pas ultra cloisonnés, et les informations ne doivent pas passer par de multiples niveaux hiérarchiques Notre équipe intervient sur des environnements variés : Systèmes & serveurs Réseaux & infrastructures Microsoft 365 / Entra ID Cybersécurité Sauvegarde & protection des données Projets d'évolution informatique Aujourd'hui, nous renforçons notre équipe avec un Administrateur Systèmes & Réseaux expérimenté. Nous recherchons surtout quelqu'un qui souhaite construire la suite de son parcours avec nous. UNE VRAIE PERSPECTIVE D'ÉVOLUTION Vous êtes aujourd'hui administrateur ou technicien confirmé ? Vous avez envie de prendre davantage de responsabilités ? Ce n’est pas un prérequis : nous vous accompagnerons dans votre évolution vers ce rôle. Nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité, de l'expérience et l'envie d'évoluer. À terme, vous pourrez notamment prendre en charge : la coordination de l'équipe technique le suivi des projets la relation technique avec certains clients la validation des choix techniques l'accompagnement des techniciens l'amélioration de nos méthodes et procédures l'organisation et la qualité de service Votre évolution dépendra de vos compétences, de votre implication et de votre envie de prendre des responsabilités. VOTRE QUOTIDIEN Vous interviendrez directement chez nos clients ou à distance. Au programme : Systèmes Windows Server Active Directory / GPO Microsoft 365 / Entra ID Virtualisation Postes de travail Réseaux TCP/IP VLAN VPN Wi-Fi Firewall Routage Cybersécurité MFA Sécurisation Microsoft 365 Protection des postes et serveurs Firewalls Sauvegarde & restauration Protection contre les ransomwares Projets Déploiements Migrations Évolution d'infrastructures Microsoft 365 Sécurité Sauvegarde Vous participerez également au support de niveau 2/3 lorsque votre expertise sera nécessaire. LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS Bac+2 à Bac+5 en informatique ou expérience équivalente Idéalement 5 ans ou plus d'expérience en systèmes et réseaux, intégration ou ESN. Une expérience sur Fortinet, Sophos, WatchGuard, Veeam, Acronis ou des technologies équivalentes est appréciée. CE QUI COMPTE POUR NOUS Nous ne cherchons pas uniquement un CV rempli de certifications. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui : aime comprendre et résoudre les problèmes sait travailler en autonomie est fiable et organisé sait prendre des initiatives aime transmettre ses connaissances sait parler technique avec un client sans jargon inutile/ langage technique compliqué apprécie le travail en équipe a envie de progresser Et surtout : quelqu'un qui souhaite progressivement davantage de responsabilités. POURQUOI REJOINDRE UNE PETITE ESN ? Parce que votre travail se voit. Vos idées peuvent réellement faire évoluer l'entreprise. Vous travaillerez directement avec la direction et l'équipe technique. Vous serez au contact des clients. Vous participerez aux décisions. Et surtout, vous ne serez pas simplement un numéro de ticket. Envoyez-nous votre CV et quelques lignes pour nous expliquer ce que vous recherchez aujourd'hui et où vous aimeriez être dans quelques années. Pas besoin d'une lettre de motivation de trois pages. jobs.title: Stage Customer Success Manager (H/F)
jobs.description: GPTW France accompagne les entreprises à transformer l’expérience de leurs collaborateurs et développer une culture de confiance, en s’appuyant sur trois leviers clés : analyse approfondie de la donnée collectée, des benchmarks pertinents et l’activation de la marque employeur. Le Customer Success Manager (CSM) est le référent opérationnel du client sur l’ensemble du cycle d’enquête. Après une période d’intégration et de formation à nos outils et process, le/la stagiaire prend progressivement en charge des projets ; il/elle participe au paramétrage et à l’administration des enquêtes sur la plateforme Emprising (outil SaaS interne), au traitement des données et aide dans la production de livrables à destination des clients. Le CSM intervient en amont et pendant l’enquête, puis passe le relais à l’Account Manager (AM) ou Key Account Manager (KAM) sur la phase post-enquête de fidélisation et de développement. Le/la stagiaire contribue à la gestion d’un portefeuille clients sur la durée du stage, accompagné(e) par son/sa tuteur/trice et/ou son binôme, et prend également part activement aux chantiers transverses de l’organisation : organisation SaaS, productivité et usage de l’IA. Vos missions Missions principales Cadrage client & pilotage de projet Participer au cadrage des projets d’enquête avec les clients sur Emprising : périmètre, planning, modalités de diffusion, contraintes techniques. Conseiller le client sur la mise en œuvre opérationnelle de l’enquête GPTW auprès de ses collaborateurs et sécuriser les jalons du projet. Echanger régulièrement avec les équipes projet chez nos clients (RH, Communication et DSI) tout au long du projet. Data, reporting & livrables Traiter les données sur notre outil de Web Reporting ROBIN. Participer à la production de livrables d’analyse : graphiques, dataviz Préparer les éléments de restitution, la présentation des résultats au client restant assurée par l’AM/KAM ou le pôle Conseil. Parcours client Contribuer à la bonne compréhension du parcours client et l’autonomie du client sur Emprising. Identifier les signaux faibles de satisfaction ou d’usage et les remonter à l’AM/KAM en charge du compte. Collaborer en binôme avec les AM / KAM pour garantir une expérience client fluide et une bonne transmission du contexte client. Vos compétences Ce stage est fait pour toi si… Tu prépares un Master 1 ou Master 2 (Bac+4/5 minimum), en école de commerce, IEP, université ou équivalent. Tu aimes la gestion de projet et le contact client, et tu sais mener plusieurs projets en parallèle avec rigueur et sens des priorités. Tu es à l’aise avec les données chiffrées et leur mise en forme. Tu connais bien le Pack Office, en particulier Excel et PowerPoint, et tu aimes découvrir de nouveaux logiciels ou outils. Tu es à l’aise avec l’apprentissage de nouveaux outils, notamment les outils d’IA. Tu es intéressé(e) par les sujets de ressources humaines : qualité de vie au travail, culture d’entreprise, RSE, performance des organisations. Tu aimes travailler en équipe. La maîtrise de l’anglais niveau professionnel est fortement recommandée, certains comptes étant gérés à l’échelle internationale. Avantages Stage à temps plein basé à Paris à pourvoir en janvier 2027. Gratification : 1000€ à 1200€ selon profil Onboarding personnalisé, avec formation et accompagnement.
