jobs.title: Graduate Program Dirigeant [H/F]
jobs.description: Graduate Program Dirigeant — Alfeor Promotion mars 2027 Le poste que vous visez : dirigeant d’une PME industrielle. Alfeor réunit des PME industrielles de la filière nucléaire et des filières souveraines (défense et aéronautique) : traitement de surface, usinage de précision, mécanosoudure, essais métallurgiques, éléments de fixation et instruments de mesure et de contrôle des fluides. Créé en 2023. Aujourd’hui 5 sites, 250 salariés, 40 M€ de chiffre d’affaires. Cible 2030 : 250 M€. Il n’existe pas d’école pour diriger une PME industrielle. Nous en avons construit une, sur le terrain. Le parcours — 18 à 24 mois, 4 phases Premier site 1. Opérateur d’atelier, 1 mois. Usinage, fraisage, chaudronnerie. Vous apprenez le geste avant de parler du reste. 2. Chef d’équipe ou de secteur production, 4 à 5 mois. Une équipe de 3 à 10 personnes, la performance de cette équipe est votre responsabilité. 3. Chargé d’affaires, 4 à 6 mois. Vous suivez une commande de la réception matière à la livraison client. Délais, marge, exigences de la filière nucléaire. Changement de site, au bout d’environ 12 mois Vous avez vu un atelier, un collectif, une affaire de bout en bout. Votre second site est choisi avec vous, en fonction de vos appétences et des besoins du groupe. 4. Responsable de la transformation, 9 à 12 mois, au CODIR. Vous êtes le relais du directeur général : chantiers d’amélioration continue, plans capex, stratégie achats, développement commercial. Vous portez un à deux projets en autonomie complète. Entre les phases, des semaines de formation : fondamentaux de la filière nucléaire, excellence opérationnelle, pilotage financier, management et RH. Revue de performance hebdomadaire avec votre DG, puis trimestrielle avec le groupe. À la sortie Un poste de direction dans une de nos filiales : production, achats, commerce, RH, pôle nucléaire, avec l’objectif d’évoluer vers la direction générale à terme. Ce poste n’est pas garanti. Le programme est sélectif et évalué à chaque rotation. Nous prenons l’engagement de vous former et de vous exposer ; vous prenez celui de faire vos preuves. Une première promotion Alfeor est un groupe industriel de dirigeants et d’équipes qui partagent une conviction : l’industrie de demain ne se décrète pas, elle se construit maintenant, sur le terrain, atelier par atelier. C’est la première promotion de ce programme. Nous l’avons conçu autour de deux principes : le terrain d’abord, et des responsabilités réelles dès les premiers mois. Une équipe à diriger, une commande à tenir, des chantiers dont vous répondez. Votre profil – Bac+5, Grande école d'ingénieur ou de commerce (Arts et Métiers, Centrale, HEC, ESSEC, ESCP), 0 à 2 ans d'expérience – Deux parcours mènent au même poste : un profil technique qui apprend le pilotage, un profil gestion qui apprend l'atelier. Nous recrutons les deux. – Vous voulez faire plutôt qu'analyser. Vous acceptez de commencer là où l'IA ne prend pas encore sa place : l'atelier. – Vous savez tenir un problème dans la durée : le poser, l'affecter, le relancer, le clore. Sur un site industriel, un sujet non suivi est un sujet perdu. – Vous êtes mobile en France. Vos deux sites d'affectation dépendront aussi des acquisitions d'Alfeor en 2027. Nos sites sont souvent éloignés des grandes villes : vous y passerez plusieurs mois loin de votre réseau habituel. – Vous visez un poste de direction en PME industrielle, sans avoir encore l'expérience du terrain qui le permet.. Concrètement – Jusqu’à 4 postes, promotion de mars 2027 – CDI, prise de poste en mars 2027 selon disponibilité – Affectation : un site du groupe, précisé en cours de process – Logement pris en charge selon localisation Candidater CV et quelques lignes sur ce qui vous attire dans ce parcours – Candidatures ouvertes jusqu’au 11 Novembre 2026 – Entretiens du 25 octobre au 20 décembre : préqualification téléphonique, entretien, puis journée d’immersion sur site avec l’équipe dirigeante – Réponses fin janvier 2027 – Prise de poste e

jobs.title: Responsable Accompagnement Clients - Transition énergétique des bâtiments
jobs.description: Chez Lowit, nous avons une ambition : accélérer et massifier la transition énergétique des bâtiments tertiaires. Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action. C'est pourquoi nous avons développé une plateforme SaaS qui permet de créer le jumeau numérique des bâtiments, de piloter les consommations énergétiques et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement réalistes, chiffrées et adaptées aux enjeux de chaque organisation. Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plusieurs centaines de collectivités et d'entreprises partout en France dans leurs projets de transition énergétique. PME lyonnaise en forte croissance, nous recherchons des collaborateurs qui souhaitent avoir un impact concret, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer à une aventure collective porteuse de sens. Vos missions Chez Lowit, nous accompagnons chaque jour des collectivités, des entreprises et des établissements publics dans la gestion et la transition énergétique de leur patrimoine immobilier. Notre plateforme leur permet de mieux connaître leurs bâtiments, de piloter leurs consommations, d'anticiper les obligations réglementaires et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement cohérentes. Parce qu'une plateforme ne crée de valeur que lorsqu'elle est pleinement appropriée par ses utilisateurs, nous accordons une place essentielle à l'accompagnement de nos clients. C'est précisément la mission de notre équipe Accompagnement Clients. Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Responsable Accompagnement Clients . Vous deviendrez l'interlocuteur privilégié d'un portefeuille de collectivités, d'entreprises et d'établissements publics. Votre mission sera de construire une relation de confiance durable avec vos clients, de comprendre leurs enjeux et de les accompagner dans l'utilisation de nos solutions afin qu'ils en tirent le meilleur parti. Concrètement, vous serez amené à : Accompagner vos clients tout au long de leur parcours chez Lowit au travers d'échanges réguliers (téléphone, visioconférences, réunions et e-mails). Développer une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux afin de leur apporter un accompagnement pertinent et personnalisé. Les conseiller sur les sujets liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments : réglementation, stratégie patrimoniale, performance énergétique, dispositifs d'aides, mécanismes de financement... en vous appuyant sur les experts internes lorsque cela est nécessaire. Réaliser ponctuellement des missions de conseil directement chez les clients afin de fiabiliser leur patrimoine, mettre à jour leurs données, construire des scénarios personnalisés et restituer des plans d'action auprès de leurs équipes de direction ou de leurs élus. Identifier les besoins émergents, détecter les opportunités d'accompagnement complémentaires et remonter les signaux business aux équipes concernées. Animer des webinaires, partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer au développement de la communauté d'utilisateurs Lowit. Faire remonter les retours clients et les besoins fonctionnels afin de contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme et de nos services. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Projets, Produit, Commerce et nos experts techniques afin de garantir un accompagnement de grande qualité. Ce poste est avant tout un métier de relation client, de conseil et d'accompagnement . Vous ne serez pas seul face aux problématiques techniques : vous pourrez vous appuyer sur les expertises présentes chez Lowit. En revanche, votre capacité à écouter, comprendre les enjeux de vos clients et construire avec eux une relation de confiance sera déterminante dans leur réussite… et dans la nôtre. jobs.title: Junior Data Consultant
jobs.description: Onze Missie LOGEX is koploper in data-analyse in de gezondheidzorg. jobs.title: Cleanroom Equipment Technician
jobs.description: Over ons De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is. In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen. De functie Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken. Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving. Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur. Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen. Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen. Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften. Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor technische uitdagingen en proactief mogelijkheden identificeren voor systeemverbeteringen en een hogere betrouwbaarheid. Jouw kwalificaties Afgeronde beroepsopleiding in een mechanische, technische of onderhoud gerelateerde richting (bijvoorbeeld automonteur, industrieel monteur, mechatronicatechnicus of vergelijkbaar). Praktische ervaring met mechanische systemen en basiskennis van elektrische, pneumatische, gas- of utiliteitssystemen. Sterke hands-on mentaliteit met het vertrouwen om onbekende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken en nieuwe technologieën te leren. Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, prioriteiten te stellen en volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor toegewezen taken. Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen. Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is. In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. About the role: Restaurant owners generally aren't on LinkedIn and they don't read e-books. They ask friends, search Google, and more and more often, they ask ChatGPT. This role is for a builder, not a strategist. You'd rather ship a working test today than a polished deck next week. You'll take ideas from the backlog to live, measure them honestly, and double down on what works. Using AI and no-code tools, you'll build pages, tools and campaigns yourself instead of relying on agencies and six-figure budgets. You'll report to the Head of Marketing, who sets direction and priorities. You'll work in deep collaboration with our other growth marketers, product marketing and creative teammates, plus embed yourself in the wider org of Sales, Account Management, RevOps, Product, and more. What you'll be doing: Ship growth experiments, fast: Take ideas from our growth backlog and get them live: landing pages, tools, ads and content. Run plenty of them, keep what works and kill what doesn't. Get Tebi recommended by AI: Own our visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews. Create and update content built to be cited, not just published, and track how often we show up compared with competitors. Build tools operators actually use: Build free tools, calculators and templates for restaurant owners, and scale our programmatic landing pages. Use no-code, AI and vibe coding tools to ship without waiting on engineering. Run creative campaigns: Help launch scrappy, unconventional campaigns across markets, from competitive campaigns to guerrilla and partner media, with the support of our Marketing team. Turn word of mouth into a channel: Test referral and sharing ideas that turn merchant word of mouth into a steady flow of demo requests. Measure everything: Keep the experiment log up to date: hypothesis, cost, result and next step. Set up tracking and UTMs properly so we know what actually drove each demo. How we'll measure success: Experiments shipped each month, and what we learned from them Demo requests from organic and other non-paid channels How often Tebi appears in AI answers for our category, by market Demos from free tools, the reservation widget and programmatic pages What you’ll bring: Think like a growth marketer but move like a hacker. You’ll do that while partnering the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn’t it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading. The role This role has two halves, and you’ll split your time roughly evenly between them. The first half is Total Rewards. You’ll own compensation and benefits at Eye, including salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling, benefits and our equity program. There’s no finished framework waiting for you. You’ll shape it, make it hold up as we grow, and get us ready for EU pay transparency. You don’t need to be a reward specialist yet. You’ll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it. What you’ll do Own Total Rewards end to end: run the annual salary review, keep our benchmarks honest, and build levelling and salary bands that make sense to managers and employees alike. Manage our equity program: grants, refreshers, and making sure people understand what their equity means. Prepare Eye for pay transparency: work with Legal and Finance so we’re ready for the EU directive, not scrambling to catch up. Be the trusted partner for leaders in security operations and customer support: coaching, challenging and advising at every level of maturity, up to and including the executive team. Be visible. This is an office where face-to-face matters: you’ll be on the floor in The Hague, listening to what’s actually going on, not partnering from a distance. Handle the real side of employee relations: sick leave and reintegration, conduct issues and complex cases, working with external counsel when needed. You’ve seen the challenging cases and you don’t flinch. Work as part of a small, tight People team: everyone picks things up, and so will you. Our problems don’t come with a manual, and you’d rather solve them creatively than wait for one. Hands-on, working knowledge of Dutch labor law, and you know when to bring in an expert. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Your mission Build the backbone of intelligent energy systems. You'll develop backend systems that turn complex optimization algorithms into reliable, real-time decisions for industrial energy systems. From the core APIs of our optimization platform to integrations with energy management systems, you make sure our platform runs fast, stable and reliable. Your work lets our customers intelligently control and optimize battery storage, photovoltaic systems, charging infrastructure and other energy assets. This isn't a job building standard CRUD applications. You'll work on the technological core of our product, where architecture decisions directly shape performance, scalability and the success of our solution. Develop backend systems You'll design, build and improve the central services of our optimization platform. You'll work on core APIs, orchestration logic and the interfaces between our systems, always aiming for robust, high-performing and maintainable solutions. Own APIs and integrations You'll integrate external energy management systems (EMS), partner solutions and customer systems. You'll build clean, well-documented APIs and handle the problems that come up in real-world use, such as incomplete data, retry mechanisms and outages of individual systems. Help shape infrastructure and operations You take responsibility for keeping our services reliable in production. From CI/CD and our cloud infrastructure (Heroku / AWS) to monitoring, alerting and performance tuning, you keep everything running smoothly. Make systems scalable You design systems from the start to grow with our customers. You spot bottlenecks early, improve observability, and keep our platform stable and fast as complexity grows. Deliver features end to end You'll work in a small, cross-functional team with a strong on-site focus. You'll own features through the whole development process, from the first idea through design and implementation to deployment and monitoring. Raise the technical bar You bring your experience to the table and set high technical standards. You help shape architecture decisions, share knowledge with the team, and help backend engineering at EnopAI keep getting better. Your profile At least 7 years of experience building and running production backend systems. Excellent Python skills and solid experience with FastAPI, asyncio, relational databases and frameworks such as SQLAlchemy. AI-first mindset: you use AI and AI agents as a normal part of your daily development work to speed up boilerplate, tests and refactoring, so you have more time for architecture, product and hard technical problems. Cloud and DevOps experience: you're confident working in cloud environments and familiar with CI/CD, infrastructure as code and running modern backend systems. A strong sense for architecture. You build solutions that work reliably today and still scale tomorrow, and you know when pragmatism matters more than perfection. Founder mindset: you take ownership, think like an entrepreneur and make technical decisions proactively instead of just implementing requirements. You enjoy working with strong engineers, give constructive feedback and hold your own work and the team's to a high standard. You value the pace of a small team and like working on-site in Munich, because fast decisions and close collaboration make a real difference to you. You speak fluent, business-level German and English. Nice to have Experience with InfluxDB or other time-series databases. Interest in energy systems, optimization algorithms or mathematical models. Why us? The pace of an ambitious startup where your ideas count and you have real influence on product and technology. A competitive salary plus extra benefits such as the EGYM Wellpass. The chance to make a concrete contribution to the energy transition through your work. A central office right at Goetheplatz in Munich, with the option to work from home by arrangement. An environment where you keep growing: togeth

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager - Issuing
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. The Role Checkout.com are actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Team in London to drive rapid growth for our revolutionary Card Issuing solution. We need a high-achieving individual to help global enterprises launch modern card programs—from virtual cards for travel intermediaries to physical cards for BNPL. If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of selling cutting edge issuing solutions in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivalled uncapped recurring commissions plan. Reporting to the Director, the Senior Sales Manager will handle multiple sales cycles, always ensuring a high conversion rate and outperforming the sales targets. Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. The ideal candidate will need to be an independent, high-achieving individual, able to stand out in an entrepreneurial environment and outperform sales targets through personal drive. How You’ll Make an Impact Pipeline Growth: Identify the most promising clients and grow a healthy pipeline for card issuing across various verticals. Solution Selling: Sell our issuing products to travel intermediaries and fintech clients through outbound techniques. Consultative Expert: Help prospects evaluate Checkout.com, handling detailed questions about our product capabilities, serving as a consultant and industry expert. Proposal Management: Prepare thorough presentations and proposals that highlight the ROI of switching to a modern issuer. Full Cycle Orchestration: Lead the entire Sales process, acting as the main point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders. Collaboration: Partner with other Sales team members to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends Market Intelligence: Provide feedback on local trends including competitor insights, customer needs, sales, product and marketing information What We’re Looking For Experience: 5+ years of Sales experience, with at least 3 years specifically within Payments or Card Issuing. Network: A solid network of potential prospects and partners. AI & Productivity: Proficient in leveraging AI-powered sales tools to augment prospecting and analyze deal intelligence to accelerate the sales cycle. Technical Passion: Tech-savvy with a passion for how technology is transforming finance. Business Acumen: Solid understanding of financial factors, including interchange mechanics and card scheme products. Soft Skills: Exceptional communication and negotiation techniques, with the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals. Tools: Knowledge of Salesforce and a highly organized approach to prioritizing shifting workloads. jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: A little about us incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime. The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join. The role in one line As our first EMEA Strategic Customer Success Manager, you’ll help define what strategic success looks like at incident.io , and become the trusted partner who makes us core to how the biggest enterprises run reliability. What that looks like day to day You’ll work with a small number of our largest, most complex and highest-value customers. These are established, often global and regulated enterprises, where buying decisions take time, many business units are involved, and incident management is part of a wider move away from legacy tools and processes. You’ll be their strategic partner across the full lifecycle, from early involvement in the deal with Sales through to adoption and expansion, and from the on-call engineer to the CIO and CTO. You’ll help land strategic logos with focused first contracts, then build the business case and success plan that turns them into larger deals. From there you’ll expand across the enterprise, mapping the organisation, finding champions and repeating proven wins across business units and regions. You’ll run Executive Business Reviews and connect our leadership with theirs, tying what we do to what matters to their business: operational resilience, regulatory risk, the cost of downtime, tool consolidation, MTTR reduction and incident process maturity. You’ll lead onboarding and migrations in organisations that move carefully, moving them off legacy tools and ITSM-led processes and making the change stick, including deeper adoption across Response, On-call, Status Pages and our AI capabilities. You’ll spot and reduce business, operational and reputational risk before it becomes visible, and bring Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing and Support together around shared goals for each account, including expansion and renewals. You’ll also work directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap and design partnerships. As the first EMEA Strategic CSM and third on the team overall, you’ll help define our strategic CS playbook, support high-stakes deals and help develop your peers as the segment grows. Who you are You have significant experience in Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management, managing strategic or Fortune 500-scale accounts in enterprise SaaS. Traditional enterprises like financial services, insurance, pharma, retail or private equity are ideal. Developer tooling, observability or incident management is a plus. You’ve driven adoption, retention and expansion in large, complex accounts with many stakeholders, and you have results you can point to. You know how to land small and grow large, turning a pilot or single business unit into a multi-BU footprint over a long sales cycle. Building a business case doesn’t faze you, nor does navigating procurement, security, legal and change management in slow-moving organisations. You’re confident with senior technical executives, running EBRs and strategic planning sessions, and just as comfortable going deep with SREs and platform engineers. You’re technically fluent in modern engineering organisations, on-call, incident response, SRE practices and the observability and DevOps ecosystem, and you can translate it for business stakeholders. You have strong commercial judgement, partner well with Sales on renewals and expansion, and get ahead of customer challenges rather than reacting to them. You’re autonomous and com

jobs.title: Director of Quality
jobs.description: About LILT AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation. We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality. At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues— Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1 —guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation , Canva , the United States Department of Defense , the United States Air Force , ASICS , and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI. Location: Remote or hybrid, EMEA or US Eastern time zone Team: Production, Quality Reports to: VP Production Direct reports: Quality Manager (AMER, customer staffing) and 2 Quality Coordinators About the role As Director of Quality, you will own LILT's quality system end to end: standards, audit, compliance, procedures, continuous improvement, and the roadmap and operation of our Quality Agents . You'll help move Quality from a primarily reactive, execution-led function to a proactive, data-driven partner for customers and internal teams, with quality designed into our AI-native workflows. You'll be the person who can run a customer audit while simultaneously shipping an improved agent evaluation. As the single Quality partner for Customer Success, Production, Research and Product, you'll turn customer requirements into measurable acceptance criteria, effective controls and better models and workflows. You'll advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix, including where automated, agent-verified and human-verified workflows are appropriate, with stronger assurance for high-risk and regulated content. We're looking for a hands-on Quality SME and operator with real depth in both worlds: experience designing and building AI agents and improving LLM output, and a solid grounding in traditional quality management. You'll bring senior expertise in data, AI, customer advisory and process, and make sure quality work prevents recurrence rather than stopping at rework or ticket closure. What you'll do Quality Agent leadership Evaluate, design and build reliable Quality Agents with well-defined tools and clear, structured instructions. Use orchestration patterns to evolve from a single agent to multi-agent systems. Define evaluation criteria, test sets and success metrics for agent performance, and run agents in production with clear monitoring and escalation paths. Drive adoption across teams and show measurable reductions in manual quality effort. Research and Product partnership Work closely with Research and Product on ADQ, LLM model improvements, AI Review, AI QA, and new and emerging AI workflows. Turn quality findings into product requirements, evaluation criteria and continuous feedback loops that improve model and workflow output. Act as the voice of quality in roadmap discussions, and help decide where human review, AI review or both are needed. Audit, compliance and procedure Own LILT's approach to internal and external audits, including ISO certification (e.g. ISO 17100, ISO 18587, ISO 9001) and customer audits. Plan and run periodic internal audits, manage evidence collection, and track corrective and preventive actions to closure. Standardise and maintain SOPs, workflows and quality documentation, and keep them current as AI workflows change how we work. jobs.description: Job Description Base salary: £33,990 - £43,775 per annum* All salaries listed on our roles are based on UK salary bands, however, if you’d like more information on the bands for your country give us a shout. Senior Digital Marketing Specialist - fixed term 12m contract A bit about Torchbox We’re the leading digital marketing agency for UK and international nonprofits. We’re proud to provide digital marketing services to the NHS, Breast Cancer Now, MSI Reproductive Choices, Disasters Emergency Committee, MND Association, Mind, Diabetes UK, MS Society, Oxfam GB and many, many more charities and organisations around the world. This is a great time to join Torchbox. Our diverse team of over 120 people is mostly UK-based but with a significant presence in Manila as well as a network of people around the world. We are on a mission to set a new standard for a purpose-led business. Torchbox is 100% employee-owned - everyone is a co-owner from day one and we are building an amazing, progressive ownership and learning culture. If you are excited about this mission, it’s a great time to join. We are looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist to join our award winning team on a 12 month fixed term contract. You’ll be supporting the planning, implementation and reporting of pay-per-click (PPC) and paid social media campaigns for some of the very biggest charities and NGOs. This role would suit someone with a few years experience working in a hands-on digital marketing role who is looking to work with organisations who make the world a better place. We are looking for someone who brings both strong employee relations expertise and the ability to build trusted relationships with operational managers. You will ideally have: CIPD Level 5 qualification (or equivalent experience). Significant experience in a generalist HR or HR Advisory role. jobs.title: SQL Developer – AI Prompting & Context Engineering
jobs.description: This is a dual role, split between approximately 60% AI-assisted development and agent orchestration, and 40% SQL Server development supporting large-scale data migration. You’ll work within the development team and report to the Software Manager, combining practical AI skills with strong SQL expertise to deliver reliable, efficient solutions. Key Responsibilities AI-Assisted Development & Agent Orchestration (c. 60%) Use AI coding assistants, such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, across the development lifecycle, including code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation and review. Build and maintain effective prompts, system instructions, reusable skills and context to produce consistent, reliable AI outputs. Design and orchestrate agents and multi-agent workflows, including task decomposition, tool use, agent hand-offs and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Connect agents to internal systems, databases and APIs, for example through MCP or function calling. Evaluate AI output for accuracy, regression, cost and latency, and refine workflows based on results. Apply appropriate safeguards for data privacy, security and hallucination risk, particularly when customer or school data is involved. Identify and prototype opportunities to apply AI to development and data migration, and share best practice by supporting and coaching colleagues. SQL Server & Data Migration (c. 40%) Design, develop and maintain scalable SQL Server T-SQL solutions and related tools for data cleansing, migration and reconciliation. Provide database performance-tuning expertise for internal and third-party systems, using AI tooling where appropriate. Define technical requirements with non-technical colleagues in the Data Migration Team, and work with third parties to understand their software and support migration projects. Manage SQL Server database environments used for data migration, including backup and recovery in test environments. Prepare and expose data safely for agents and AI workflows, using AI to support SQL query generation, code review and optimisation. Plan and prioritise work independently, managing tasks against project timelines and requirements. The Ideal Candidate You’ll combine hands-on AI-assisted development skills with substantial SQL Server experience. You’ll be curious and adaptable, communicate clearly, and use good judgement to assess AI-generated output rather than accepting it uncritically. Demonstrable experience using AI coding tools and writing effective prompts, with practical examples of workflows or agents you have built. Substantial SQL programming experience and strong knowledge of the techniques and capabilities of Microsoft SQL Server 2017 or later. A strong grounding in data modelling, data management and data manipulation, alongside Git, version control and attention to detail. The ability to investigate problems independently, collaborate with colleagues and communicate clearly in writing and in person. Essential Skills Practical experience with AI coding assistants and strong prompting skills, supported by examples. Strong SQL Server T-SQL development and performance tuning, including experience supporting SQL Server in a large-scale environment. Experience with Git and version control. Excellent teamwork, communication and documentation skills. Desirable Skills Experience building agents or multi-agent workflows using Claude Code, MCP or similar frameworks. Familiarity with LLM APIs, evaluation approaches and prompt testing. Scripting or programming experience in Python or a similar language. Awareness of AI data protection and security considerations. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly. We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there! Responsibilities In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.  You will:  - Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup  - Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android  - Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use  - Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting  - Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+. Notre prochain enjeu : scaler à grande échelle sans perdre la vélocité qui fait aujourd’hui partie de notre manière de travailler. Chez Bricks, on attend de chacun qu’il comprenne vraiment les problèmes avant de chercher à les résoudre. L’objectif : prendre les bonnes décisions et construire des solutions utiles. Sur ce poste, ton travail aura un impact direct sur la qualité du suivi des projets et sur la confiance des investisseurs comme des porteurs de projets. Une plateforme d’investissement ne se construit pas uniquement au moment où un utilisateur décide d’investir : elle se construit dans la durée, dans la qualité du suivi et dans la façon dont les situations plus complexes sont prises en charge. Le challenge n’est pas simplement de “gérer 400 projets”. Il est de construire un système capable d’en gérer demain beaucoup plus sans faire grossir l’équipe au même rythme. Une plateforme existe déjà et accompagne l’équipe au quotidien. Elle a atteint un niveau de maturité où les prochains problèmes ne se résoudront pas uniquement avec de nouvelles features : parfois la meilleure réponse sera produit, parfois process, parfois automatisation, parfois juridique. Faire évoluer la gestion de plusieurs centaines de projets pour qu’elle reste fluide et scalable : priorisation, automatisation, workflows, process et outils. Travailler avec l’engineering pour transformer les problèmes identifiés en solutions produit lorsqu’une solution technique est pertinente. Aller chercher l’information là où elle se trouve : care, juridique, marketing, métier, engineering… Tu ne travailles pas à partir d’une spec parfaite, tu reconstruis toi-même le contexte. T’approprier des sujets parfois complexes ou réglementaires. Tu n’as pas besoin d’être juriste, mais un contrat de 50 pages ou une discussion sur un process de contentieux ne doit pas te faire fuir. jobs.title: Flight Test Instrumentation & Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & Data Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end handling, quality assurance, accessibility, and long-term management of all flight data. The primary objective is to ensure that full-aircraft data, from the onboard sensors and DAQ systems to the final processing tools, is available to every engineering team through a reliable, efficient, and standardized workflow. Tasks Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & DAQ Pipeline Manage the data pipeline from the physical sensor and Data Acquisition (DAQ) level for the full aircraft, ensuring seamless and accurate transmission into the telemetry and storage systems. Maintain sensor configuration, calibration records, and metadata to guarantee the accurate translation of raw physical signals into usable engineering units. Collaborate with hardware, software and integration teams to define sensor requirements, DAQ architectures, scaling, and telemetry bandwidth allocations. Troubleshoot and resolve data anomalies at the DAQ and sensor level (e.g., signal noise, dropouts, faulty scaling) before they propagate into downstream databases. Data Infrastructure & Accessibility Maintain reliable extraction of flight data from InfluxDB. Develop and maintain standardized local data structures for analysis, plotting, and visualization. Optimize access to large flight datasets while minimizing CPU and memory usage. Design and maintain an efficient local storage solution for processed flight data. Support future improvements to the flight data architecture as storage requirements, sensor counts, and analysis needs continue to evolve. Data Quality & Analysis Support Maintain derived datasets to ensure common calculations and signals are shared consistently across teams. Ensure strict timing synchronization and timestamp accuracy across all recorded data, from the sensor acquisition point to the database. Monitor data quality, completeness, and integrity throughout the entire pipeline. Provide fast data previews for rapid post-flight reviews. Enable efficient access to high-frequency sensor data for detailed engineering investigations. Support custom querying of processed datasets. Requirements Education & Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field. 3+ years of professional experience in test instrumentation, data acquisition (DAQ), or sensor-to-database time-series data engineering (aerospace, automotive, or racing/motorsports preferred). Hands-on experience working directly with physical aircraft/vehicle sensor installations, DAQ hardware, and telemetry pipelines. Technical & Domain Expertise 1. Hardware, Sensors & DAQ Architecture Strong understanding of physical sensors (e.g., strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, RTDs, LVDTs, pitot-static tubes). Demonstrated knowledge of signal conditioning, sampling rate selection, anti-aliasing filtering, scaling, and sensor calibration procedures. 2. Data Infrastructure & Software Development Proficient in Python or MATLAB for data analysis, automated data processing, and visualization library development (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy). Experience working with time-series databases, specifically InfluxDB (or similar engines), including writing efficient queries (Flux/InfluxQL) and data retrieval pipelines. Solid foundation in data structures and memory/CPU optimization when handling high-memory high-frequency continuous time-series datasets. 3. Data Integrity & Signal Processing Experience with timestamping and clock synchronization protocols across distributed DAQ hardware and storage nodes. Knowledge of basic digital signal processing (DSP) concepts (filtering, FFT, spectral analysis, decimation/resampling). Soft Skills & Work Style Cross-functional communication: Ability to bridge the gap between hardware technicians, flight physics/aerodynamics engineers, and software teams. Detail-oriented mindset: U

jobs.title: Directeur·rice du Summer Camp
jobs.description: Saint-Charles International School recherche un·e Directeur·rice du Summer Camp dynamique, organisé·e et enthousiaste pour rejoindre son équipe et participer au développement et à l’organisation de son programme d’été international. Ce poste représente une excellente opportunité pour une personne en début de carrière souhaitant acquérir rapidement des responsabilités dans un environnement international, notamment dans les domaines de l’événementiel, de l’éducation, de l’hospitalité, de la gestion de projet et du management. Notre Summer Camp accueille des jeunes de 10 à 15 ans venant du monde entier. Vous serez impliqué·e dans toutes les étapes du programme : préparation, organisation des activités, coordination des équipes, communication avec les familles et gestion opérationnelle pendant l’été. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne motivée, polyvalente, débrouillarde et orientée solutions , qui souhaite s’investir dans un projet international et évoluer avec celui-ci. Vos missions Organisation du Summer Camp Vous participez à la préparation et à la coordination de l’ensemble du Summer Camp tout au long de l’année. Vous créez les programmes hebdomadaires en combinant cours, sports, activités culturelles, excursions et loisirs. Vous organisez les différentes activités du camp : excursions, soirées à thème, événements, animations et programmes spéciaux. Vous recherchez également régulièrement de nouvelles activités et idées permettant d’améliorer l’expérience proposée aux élèves. Coordination de l’équipe Vous participez au recrutement et à l’intégration des collaborateurs saisonniers. Pendant le Summer Camp, vous préparez les plannings, coordonnez les équipes et participez activement à la gestion quotidienne du programme. Vous contribuez à créer une ambiance de travail positive, dynamique et collaborative au sein d’une équipe jeune et internationale. Encadrement des élèves Vous veillez au bien-être et à la sécurité des élèves pendant leur séjour. En collaboration avec les équipes de Saint-Charles, vous participez à la vie quotidienne du camp et accompagnez les jeunes tout au long de leur expérience. Vous devez être capable de réagir rapidement et avec calme en cas d’imprévu, de problème ou de situation nécessitant une prise de décision. Communication avec les familles Vous êtes en contact avec des familles venant du monde entier avant et pendant le Summer Camp. Vous répondez à leurs questions, les accompagnez durant le processus d’inscription et veillez à maintenir une communication professionnelle, chaleureuse et personnalisée. Un excellent sens du service et de la communication est donc essentiel. Admissions et administration Vous participez au suivi des inscriptions et des dossiers des élèves. Vous vous assurez que les informations et documents nécessaires sont complets et à jour et participez à la coordination des arrivées et départs. Logistique Vous coordonnez les activités, excursions, transports et différents prestataires du Summer Camp. Vous travaillez en collaboration avec les différents départements de l’école : Admissions, Boarding, Académique, Marketing, Restauration, Maintenance et Finance. Budget Vous participez à la préparation et au suivi du budget du Summer Camp et veillez au respect des budgets définis pour les différentes activités. Marketing et promotion En collaboration avec l’équipe Marketing, vous participez à la promotion du Summer Camp. Vous contribuez à la préparation et à la mise à jour des brochures, présentations et différents supports promotionnels. Selon les besoins, vous pourrez également participer à des salons, événements, webinaires ou rencontres avec des partenaires et agents internationaux afin de présenter Saint-Charles et son Summer Camp. Vos compétences Nous recherchons davantage une personnalité et un potentiel qu’un parcours professionnel senior. Ce poste pourrait notamment convenir à un·e jeune diplômé·e ou à une personne disposant de quelques premières expériences professionnelles

jobs.description: Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour. We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week. Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company . You might enjoy Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage , or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like . About the role Monumental are already deploying robots into the real world at scale, building beautiful, bespoke homes. Our robots are on sites across the Netherlands and the UK and will be in the US within a year. Every deployment teaches us something about our hardware; you’ll push our R&D fleet to become one ready for large-series production: you'll own taking us from tens of robots a year to hundreds, and then thousands. You'll also keep that growing fleet deployable, and making design changes yourself to improve reliability and serviceability. Scaling a fleet means solving whatever is in the way: limited space, no clear production process, lead times we can't live with and modules that don't survive the harsh conditions of a construction site. You’ll be expected to wear many hats; we’re looking for people who are genuinely excited to lead these efforts. Our robots are built from modules at every level of maturity, so expect to work with the hardware R&D team at early stages of development to validate R&D designs as fast as we can. In parallel, you'll be in the workshop determining how we assemble them: the processes, the fixtures, the production space itself, getting the very best out of our Amsterdam facilities. For more context on building hardware at Monumental, read Niall’s Substack: I quit my job and moved country to make robots that will fix Europe’s housing crisis. What you'll do Bottom line, you'll own increasing our quarterly production from 30 sets of robot systems to 100 within a year. This is a challenge. You'll be building the production capabilities at Monumental rather than inheriting them, and you'll do it alongside engineers and technicians who care a great deal about getting this right. Take prototypes through to production-ready modules. Find and address design flaws, validate improvements, and push these modules to production. Assembling modules, understand the friction slowing production, and address issues yourself along with the hardware team. Develop fixtures, jigs and light automation solutions to support module assembly. Find production processes that bring minimal value when done in-house. Work with external suppliers to outsource them, while maintaining production quality. Produce drawings, assembly instructions and quality checks to make sure our modules are integrated together and our robots are brought up with no errors. jobs.description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.<br><br><strong>Kimchi Inference</strong></p> <p>One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.<br><br></p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.</p> <p>Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. jobs.title: Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router)
jobs.description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and the router deciding which model answers each request is ours too.<br><br><strong>The Auto Router</strong></p> <p>Our promise is one enforcement layer for your AI: budgets, spend attribution, and model routing, applied before a request ever hits a model. The Auto Router makes the call: for every request, which model serves it. Eight open-source models whose input prices span more than 20×, cached input up to 50× cheaper than fresh, frontier providers on customers' own keys, and a coding agent that fires hundreds of requests before its task is done. Frontier-level task success at a fraction of the token cost: that sentence is the product, and it stays true only if the model inside the router keeps getting better. That model is yours.</p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made </span></em><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Every request gets a decision: which model serves it.</p> <p>This is an applied-ML seat, not an infrastructure one. You own the model inside them: the training data, the objective, the evaluation, and the iteration loop that ships a better router every cycle.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> routing is a prediction problem wearing a product's clothes. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role Pleo's Intelligence function covers the full analytical picture - product behaviour, GTM performance, commercial data science, financial reporting, and operational intelligence. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers. You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. If you want to build the infrastructure that other people's product decisions run on rather than just report on what exists, this is the opportunity for you. Who you'll work with and reporting to You will report to an Analytics Manager leading Product Intelligence and Growth Intelligence. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Engineering to get tracking, experimentation, and metric definitions right from the ground up. You'll also engage with the broader Analytics Engineering community across Pleo to drive shared standards, especially around the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across the organization. Own tracking plan implementation and QA directly in Segment and Amplitude in close partnership with Product and Engineering. Support experimentation by modelling assignment and outcome data into structured formats that analysts and PMs can query directly. Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers. Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code. Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models. Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring. What you bring Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end. Working knowledge of event-based tracking tools like Segment or Amplitude. Experience with Git-based development workflows, including opening and reviewing pull requests. Clear communication skills to explain data definitions and structures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. jobs.title: Marketing Analyst, Attribution - ShareGate
jobs.description: Company Description Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent , our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here. Your role ShareGate is a close to $100M ARR business that grows through two very different engines: inbound and channel. We've just finished our CRM migration and locked down our revenue architecture, which means for the first time the data is clean enough to answer the question we've never been able to answer properly — what marketing actually drives revenue, and where the next dollar should go. This role exists to own that answer. You'll be the analytical counterpart to our marketing ops lead, working side by side with ShareGate's Director of Marketing to turn campaign and attribution data into decisions the marketing team and the exec team can act on. Your impact: Own ShareGate's marketing attribution architecture across HubSpot and HockeyStack, and translate funnel data into exec-ready narratives, so attribution questions get one clear answer; Drive marketing performance by diagnosing what's working and what isn't across inbound and channel, so budget shifts to the highest-return programs every quarter instead of every fiscal year; Build the reporting and diagnostic layer for ShareGate marketing — campaign performance, funnel conversion, source quality — so the team plans against measured conversion rates, not assumptions; Integrate AI into the analysis workflow — we run on Claude — to compress the time from question to answer from days to hours, and to make deep-dive analysis a weekly habit rather than a quarterly project. Your team The next 6 to 12 months are a build. This role has never existed at Workleap, and you're inheriting a business that just finished cleaning its foundations: the CRM migration is done, the revenue architecture is set, and attribution visibility is still scattered across two systems. Your first mandate is to make that architecture coherent and legible — then use it to tell ShareGate's marketing team where to invest and where to pull back. RevOps at Workleap is split into two halves. One is Systems & Operations, which owns automation, CRM architecture and AI GTM tooling. The other — yours — is a group of GTM business partners embedded with the business units they serve, accountable for their stakeholder's performance: forecasting, funnel conversion, quota attainment, velocity. You'll report to the Director of RevOps and pair tightly with our Marketing Ops Manager, who owns the systems and campaign execution, while you own the data and its interpretation. What you'll bring 3+ years in marketing operations or marketing analytics at a B2B SaaS, software or fintech company; Deep hands-on HubSpot expertise — non-negotiable. You've built, broken and rebuilt campaign, lifecycle and reporting logic inside it; A real command of attribution models — first touch, last touch, multi-touch — and the judgment to know which one answers which question; Fluency with the mechanics underneath: UTM governance, lead routing and round robins, lifecycle stages, source and channel taxonomy; An analyst's instinct: you chase the "why" behind a number before anyone asks you to; The ability to take a messy dataset and turn it into a two-slide answer a CRO can act on; Deliberate daily use of AI to accelerate your own analysis — not just to draft copy; Bonus: experience with HockeyStack or a comparable attribution platform. Most of this sounds like you? Apply. What the job comes with Base salary: $100k to $130k / OTE: $11

As a Staff Research Engineer, you'll join the Voice team within our 40+ person R&D department, but your scope will extend well beyond voice. Lead post-training initiatives like DPO, fine-tuning, and distillation to bring models to shipping quality. Ship models to production with optimised runtime to serve customers, and address their feedback thereafter. A demonstrated ability to prototype quickly, test hypotheses, and iterate efficiently. Proven experience training deep learning models end-to-end, from data preparation through evaluation. jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The role: We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production. The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics. We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start. This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance. What you'll do: Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly. Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build. Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them. Work across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and be honest about which a problem actually needs: a propensity or uplift model, a policy of rules, or an agent with tools, evals against golden answer sets and trace-level observability. Several of our strongest candidate use cases point each way. Build and lead the team — hire senior data scientists embedded in value areas and machine learning engineers in the hub, and set the professional standards, shared methods and reusable components the function runs on. Establish the production stack alongside Data Platform and Engineering: reproducible training data, code and artefacts; a model registry; inference services with real latency, availability and rollback requirements; historically accurate features where decisions

Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with. Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance. Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights. jobs.title: Research Scientist - Personalization
jobs.description: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify ’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.Spotify’s Personalization organization builds the technology that helps millions of listeners discover what they love. Within this space, our research team focuses on advancing the state of the art in machine learning and AI to shape the future of personalization. We explore new approaches, challenge existing assumptions, and contribute to the broader research community while influencing long-term product direction. What You'll Do Conduct original research in machine learning and AI, with a focus on large-scale foundation models, generative AI, and post-training methods, including reinforcement learning. Develop novel methodologies, models, and evaluation frameworks to advance personalization systems. Design and execute rigorous experiments to explore new ideas and validate research hypotheses. Contribute to the scientific community through publications, talks, and conference participation. Collaborate with cross-functional partners to translate research insights into long-term product opportunities. Help define and evolve a forward-looking research agenda aligned with Spotify’s personalization strategy. Mentor others and contribute to a strong, curious, and collaborative research culture. Who You Are You have a Master’s or PhD in machine learning, AI, or a related field, or equivalent research experience. You have demonstrated expertise in machine learning and artificial intelligence through peer-reviewed publications at conferences such as NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, KDD, or RecSys. You have deep knowledge of machine learning, with hands-on experience in areas such as post-training and reinforcement learning for large models, reward design, large-scale distributed training, or evaluation of model behavior. You are experienced in designing experiments and working with real-world datasets to validate research ideas. You care about advancing understanding of user behavior and improving experiences across music and talk content. You bring curiosity, creativity, and a thoughtful approach to solving complex, open-ended problems. You value collaboration and actively seek diverse perspectives in your work. Where You'll Be This role is based in London. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Compensation Additional Information Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

The Product Manager will ensure Acxiom ’s cleanroom and delivery solutions meet client needs while remaining scalable, interoperable, commercially viable, and aligned with Acxiom ’s Real Identity and data strategy. Duties and Responsibilities Product Strategy and Ownership Serve as the product owner for client and partner cleanroom implementations and supporting data delivery platform capabilities. Define product strategy, roadmaps, and priorities for privacy-conscious data collaboration and delivery solutions. Establish a consistent approach for supporting Acxiom data, client first-party data, and partner data within cleanroom and Acxiom environments. Align product direction with Acxiom ’s Real Identity, data enrichment, activation, measurement, and platform modernization strategies. Balance client and partner specific implementation requirements with the development of scalable, reusable product capabilities. Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize data onboarding, permissions, processing, and delivery across clients and partners. Clean-Room Product Management Lead product planning and execution for client and partner-based clean-room implementations. Define requirements for data ingestion, identity resolution, data matching, enrichment, collaboration, analysis, measurement, and activation. Establish repeatable implementation patterns that reduce time to market and improve consistency across cleanroom providers and client environments. Partner with clients and providers to define supported use cases, data flows, identity requirements, access controls, outputs, and success criteria. Develop product requirements supporting both one-to-one client implementations and scalable one-to-many partner solutions. Ensure cleanroom capabilities support appropriate interoperability with Acxiom Real Identity and related data products. Manage platform and partner dependencies, including changes that may affect existing client implementations. Data Delivery Platform Management Own the product strategy for platforms that house, process, and deliver Acxiom and client-owned data. Establish requirements for secure data ingestion, storage, transformation, permissioning, access, distribution, and monitoring. Support delivery through batch files, APIs, cloud storage, database sharing, and other approved delivery methods. Partner with architecture and engineering to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency. Drive modernization of legacy delivery workflows and migration to reusable platform services. Define operational tools and controls needed by delivery, implementation, support, and client-facing teams. Client and Partner Implementation Translate client and partner needs into prioritized product requirements, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes. Participate in technical and business design sessions covering data flows, identity, permitted uses, delivery methods, and platform integration. Provide product leadership throughout implementation, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization. Develop repeatable implementation playbooks, requirements templates, and readiness criteria. Ensure custom implementation work is evaluated for broader product applicability and potential reuse. Supervisory Responsibilities This position does not typically have direct reports but is expected to mentor other product managers and provide leadership across cross-functional client, partner, product, engineering, and delivery teams.
